competing_explanation: Any apparent high-versus-low difference could reflect spatial image content or model error rather than the qualified tau field. The within-scene 180-degree tau rotation preserves each scene's tau distribution while breaking its spatial alignment. Passing still identifies only a descriptive synthetic-domain behavior of one fixed model instance; it does not prove that tau causes the error or that a particular module will repair it.
controls: strict identity-bound official checkpoint and official production graph
full-image input-to-output MSE improvement as an OTS global-competence prerequisite
180-degree spatial rotation of tau within the same scene as a marginal-distribution-preserving negative control
paired clear GT and identical resize/crop for input, output, depth, and regions
all three beta variants nested within the original clear scene
disabled_actions: training, fine-tuning, module insertion, candidate selection, loss selection, or hyperparameter search
using model output to define tau or region membership
treating a spatial association as causal mechanism evidence
treating OTS synthetic optical thickness as a validated real-haze restoration-demand label
SOTS, Haze4K outcome, NH-HAZE, confirmation, canary, or locked-test access
changing scene membership, variants, regions, metrics, margins, controls, or terminal rules after outcomes

gates.estimand: parent terminal tuple, 625-scene list, official checkpoint and exact model-source identities match
independent scenes with all three fixed variants, aligned depth and finite inference
Wilson lower 95 percent bound for scenes whose full-image output MSE is below input MSE in at least two of three severities
Wilson interval for tau-aligned scene mismatch prevalence
included in every variant indicator as true low-high correction imbalance minus rotated-tau imbalance

fixed_factors: scene membership is exactly the 625 validation IDs archived by reside-ots-outdoor-measurement-v1
official variants are airlight 0.90 crossed with beta 0.04, 0.10, and 0.20
each image preserves aspect ratio with long edge at most 320 pixels and is reflect-padded to a multiple of 32 for official inference
official build_net('base','Haze4K') is strictly loaded from checkpoint state_dict['model'] and model(input)[2] is cropped and clipped to [0,1]
pixel input error is mean RGB squared error between hazy input and clear GT; output error replaces input with clipped model output
relative correction is (mean input error minus mean output error) divided by mean input error, with fixed epsilon 1e-8
true low and high regions are the within-scene bottom and top 20 percent of tau; the negative control rotates tau 180 degrees before forming the same quantiles
a variant mismatch requires true low-minus-high relative correction at least 0.10 and true-minus-control imbalance at least 0.05
a scene mismatch requires the variant rule in at least two of the three fixed beta severities
pixels, regions, beta variants, and metrics are nested summaries and never independent samples
missing or failed scene inference remains visible and cannot be silently excluded
intervention.matched_budget: 625 independent scenes times exactly three nested official variants; one fixed checkpoint; zero training or model selection
intervention.reference: paired hazy input versus clear GT, with true tau regions compared against the same tau field rotated 180 degrees within scene

primary_estimand.aggregation: scene-level binary indicator with two-sided Wilson 95 percent interval
primary_estimand.metric: proportion of 625 independent OTS clear scenes meeting the frozen tau-aligned mismatch indicator in at least two of three severities

question: On the exact 625 qualified OTS validation scenes, does the fixed official Haze4K ConvIR-B baseline show a material and tau-aligned local restoration mismatch, after requiring adequate global OTS competence and separation from a spatially rotated tau negative control?

uncertainty.method: two-sided Wilson 95 percent intervals over independent original clear scenes; severity and pixel summaries remain nested
